title: Morning rush in Kuala Lumpur: every bus, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in Kuala Lumpur, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every bus inside the city on an average October weekday.

The timetables are from October 2026. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside the Kuala Lumpur city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Trunk, Local and MRT feeder, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment of the morning: 198 buses at 7:30 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable.
